name: Cafe Neurotico
author: Jose
description: Your game library in the bar: how many games are installed, and what is running right now. Click to open Cafe Neurotico, middle-click for CREMA on the couch.

barWidget.description: Installed games, and what is playing.

schema.label: Cafe Neurotico command
schema.description: The AppImage to open. Middle-click launches the same binary with --crema for the couch face.

schema.label: GRINDER database
schema.description: grinder.db, which holds what is installed. Set explicitly rather than guessed — a second consumer deriving its own path is exactly how the library got orphaned once before.

schema.label: Refresh seconds
schema.description: How often to re-check. The running-game check is cheap; the install count is only re-read when the database changes.
